'''Rordan's Spaceship Parts and More''' was a sand-[[Color/Legends|colored]] building owned and operated by [[Aarica Vost|Bren-Aarica Rordan]] in [[Verena City]] on [[Kirima (Kalinda system)|Kirima]]. The large display area held every conceivable [[Starship/Legends|starship]] part and tool available.<ref name="DS" />
